scope: VCVio deprecation migration, stage S3 (plan doc/impl/vcvio-deprecation-migration-plan.md section 7: PqxdhProjection*, PqxdhHidden*, PqxdhExtract*): restatement of 57 theorems of the three large proof files PqxdhProjectionCollisions, PqxdhHiddenRoot and PqxdhExtractRomHiddenSuffix in VCVio's forward vocabulary (Pr{let x <- mx}[...] and EvalDistEq), with out-of-build inverse-map certificates; two transitional twins and their ten later-stage consumer declarations; phase B proof rewrites in these files; Lean-only validation.

commits.a8c9c2de96208b4e57df0732b0f52716d7ed6cda: Migrate VCVio stage S3 to the forward probability vocabulary
commits.docs: the commit that adds this receipt

owner_decisions.item 4 (decision 2026-10-19): D1-D5 and D8-D11 as recommended in plan section 11; D6 phase B included
owner_decisions.item 5 (decision 2026-10-19, revising D7: Lean-only validation per stage: make check-lean, make check-inventory, the step 7 scans and the certificates; no verify-in-shell, ProVerif, transcript fidelity, cargo, Go or Python checks
owner_decisions.amendments: A1, A1.1 and A2 items 1-3 (/tmp/bc-arc-scratch/vcvio-migration/AMENDMENTS.md, recorded in the plan copy); A2 item 4 pending the owner

lean_changes.statements: probOutput -> Pr{let x <- mx}[x = a]; probEvent -> Pr{let x <- mx}[p x] (old lambda binder names kept; a bare predicate p becomes Pr{let x <- mx}[p x], which the certificate's inverse map rebuilds by eta reduction); evalSPMF A = evalSPMF B and 𝒮[A] = 𝒮[B] -> EvalDistEq A B (amendment A1, no =ᵈ), including the hypothesis of the private transport lemma evalSPMF_map_run_simulateQ_eq_of_query_map_evalSPMF_eq
lean_changes.editing: whole-declaration blocks written from the originals (S3/edits/blocks-*.lean, tools/declrep.py), multi-line computations inside Pr{...} parenthesized (tools/prparen.py); the pin-filtered codemod output (logs/codemod.log) served as a reference only

findings.semantics_instance: adapter users after the stage: BeaconcryptCore.Computational.CtxRomAuth, BeaconcryptCore.Computational.StatefulGoodEvent, BeaconcryptCore.Computational.VCVioLegacyBridge (the bridge and stage S2's adapter class only; every ProbComp use in the three modules is native)
findings.calc_trans: a calc step EvalDistEq _ (do ...) leaves the monad of the do block undetermined, and the Trans instance of EvalDistEq is not found; the steps pin (m := ProbComp) (m' := ProbComp)
findings.layout: a continuation line inside Pr{...} at or left of the column of its let ends the doSeq; multi-line computations are parenthesized
findings.uniform_query: the uniform-query step of the eager-coordinate law, earlier closed through OracleComp.evalSPMF_query, closes by EvalDistEq.rfl: $ᵗ unifSpec.Range n unfolds through SampleableType.Fin to unifSpec.query n
findings.twin_tool_defect: twins.py did not parse the twin TEXT header lines of CertTools 987e93df (S2 review fix EQ-S2-2 appends '; information: binders ...' inside the parenthesis); the header regex now accepts that clause and still parses the earlier format (S3/tools/twins.py, provenance copy twins.s2.py.txt)
findings.identical_until_bad: every identical-until-bad lemma of the pinned VCVio (probEvent_output_bad_eq', tvDist_simulateQ_run_le_probEvent_output_bad and its variants) is stated in the deprecated form; the three proofs that use them reach them through the bridge

build.command: make -C beaconcrypt-core check-lean SHELL=bash (proof shell, two-file flake copy of central's flake.nix/flake.lock)
build.partial_build: lake build of the three stage modules (logs/lake-stage-1.log): rc 0, 39 modules rebuilt, before the twins were inserted

spmf_only_report.what: declarations whose type or definition body references SPMF but no deprecated statement head (report only)

G4.note_generated_type_changes: Of the four generated helpers in type_changed_unexpected (allowed_generated), only probEvent_projectionCacheBad12_run_le_sum_aux._proof_1_6 and probEvent_projectionCacheBad32_run_le_sum_aux._proof_1_6 changed their type hash: they are arithmetic side goals of the rewritten proofs, not translated statements (after the same premises on the cache keys, base: 0 < m -> not m = m - 1 + 1 -> False; stage: forall j, not k + 1 + j = k + (j + 1) -> False; review-fix probe HelperTypes.lean on the base and stage builds). The two _proof_1_4 differ only in macro-scoped binder names: type hash, value hash and the scope-erased fingerprint are equal, only the raw binder-aware fingerprint differs (S3 review finding EQ-S3-2; see vcvio-deprecations-s3-review.json).

allowed_generated.note: generated auxiliary declarations of explained parents (restated, edited or twin declarations); type_changed_unexpected and levels_changed list every change outside the configured allowlist, the gate criterion is unexplained_type_changes and unexplained_levels_changes
